projects.title: CLI Coding Agent
projects.content: Repo: https://github.com/hangtiancheng/swifty-cli; a lightweight CLI Coding Agent; 5-layer architecture supporting multiple LLM providers; an AI-friendly toolset; based on the ReAct paradigm, driving the LLM to autonomously complete coding tasks through an Agent Loop that alternates between reasoning and action; System Prompt assembly; a 5-layer permission system; MCP support; safe, high-quality context compression; instruction files, session persistence, and LLM-driven automatic memory extraction with periodic memory consolidation; support for Slash Commands, Skills, and Hooks; implemented worktree file isolation, predefined/forked Subagents, and Agent Teams with multi-teammate collaboration; added support for image content blocks

projects.title: Frontend Tracking / Performance Monitoring
projects.content: Repo: https://github.com/hangtiancheng/swifty-sentry; a framework-agnostic frontend monitoring SDK with a publish-subscribe architecture, decoupling the core module from plugin submodules; supports error capture, blank-screen detection, performance-metric collection, and failure-scene replay; error capture covers resource-loading errors, JSErrors, uncaught Promise errors, and xhr/fetch request errors, with LRU and error deduplication, and traces user behavior such as click events and route transitions; blank-screen detection uses key-point sampling; the performance-metric module computes metrics such as LCP/FCP/CLS/INP and uses the Observer API to measure first-screen render time and detect long tasks; uses rrweb + gzip screen recording to replay failure scenes, with 3-level degradation for data reporting: navigator.sendBeacon -> Image beacon -> fetch keepAlive, offline storage via localStorage, and automatic flushing of the reporting queue when the network recovers

research: Research focus: reinforcement learning for computer network congestion control, multi-core parallelized network simulation
